components.name: MRN Pre-Consent Update Backup

distribution_values.catalog-only: Available source is cataloged but not currently installed by the stack bootstrap.
distribution_values.mu-loader: Currently loaded by the MRN MU loader.
distribution_values.mu-source-only: Source exists in the MU tree but is not in the current loader allowlist.
distribution_values.standard-bootstrap: Currently listed in stack/manifests/plugins.txt and activated by new-site bootstrap.
distribution_values.tooling-only: Agent or operator tooling that is never installed on a WordPress site.

external_unknowns.note: Sunset approved on 2026-08-14. No source exists in either audited shared root; it is not part of the target MRN product catalog. This classification does not authorize changes to existing sites.

product_model.archive-candidate: Likely superseded or redundant; no archive action is authorized by this classification.
product_model.dashboard-only: Installed only on an MRN/MainWP management runtime.
product_model.development-only: Permitted in development tooling but excluded from production defaults.
product_model.maintenance-only: Installed temporarily or deliberately for an operational task.
product_model.optional-integration: Adapter installed only with its third-party service or plugin.
product_model.optional-shared: Stack-agnostic or shared feature installed only when a site needs it.
product_model.platform-required: Installed on a production MRN stack because it provides mandatory platform behavior.
product_model.review: Classification or support decision is not final and requires an approval-gated review.
